entry.title: Well Dweller v0.2.3a0
entry.content:
# Release notes
## v0.2.3-alpha APWorld 0.2.3 + game mod 0.1.13. **Update both** (`well_dweller.apworld` and `WellDwellerAP.dll`) and start a new save for a new seed. **New YAML template:** `currency_item_amount` is replaced by `currency_item_total`. Older YAMLs still generate, but their `currency_item_amount` is ignored (with a warning).
### Currency and shop - New option `currency_item_total` (0-500, default 150): all Currency items from the multiworld together give this percentage of what the whole Looter's shop costs at your seed's prices (the six trinkets, the Oil Vial, both Flaming Vessel upgrades and all 100 Trinket Points). The amount stays the same whichever checks you turn on. - `currency_multiplier` now only multiplies the currency you pick up in the game (enemies and vessels). - Shop checks come into logic much earlier: each purchase only needs its own price (the second Flaming Vessel upgrade and later Trinket Points also count the earlier ones), all currency in the areas you can reach counts, and the shop opens up after 5% of the map (plus 2 movement abilities). Currency items are never counted by the logic.
### In the game - The HUD counter also shows how many checks are in logic right now ("Checks: found / total In logic: n"). Needs both the new mod and the new apworld.
### Locations - New: Desiccated Castle Combat Room (AC_14). Up to 621 locations.
### Logic More fixes from player reports: - Time trials need the right abilities on top of reaching them: Night Garden Climb + Slingshot/Wall Sling or Soar + Hover; Gravenvalley Climb + Slingshot/Wall Sling; Hunter's Cabin Climb + Slingshot/Wall Sling/Hover; Autumn Forest Hover. - Hunter's Cabin: the upper part needs Soar or Climb + Hover; AH_05 trinket from the lower part. - The Docks to the Depths: Water Vessel + Climb + Hover (the barge leaves from the right side). - Lookout Tower AG_13, AG_15, AG_17 and AG_28 checks, and the Autumn Forest area around the Forest King, need Hover. - Drains AP_28 checks: Wind Ride + Hover + (Climb + Slingshot, or Soar). - Smaller fixes: AN_11 page (Climb is enough), castle AC_03/AC_05 levers (Drains elevator side), AF_34 page (behind the Forest King), Burial Vault AT_InsideTomb_after slot (Climb + Wall Sling or Soar).
### Setup guide - The Aurie Installer links point straight to the Aurie v2.0.0b release.
### Game mod (0.1.13) - HUD shows the in-logic count from the client.
### Known issues - The game's own Spirit Nest counts the Spirit Fragments you picked up in the world, not the ones you received, so you may need to collect all 5 in the world yourself before the nest turn-in works. The `final_flock` goal only completes once you have received them too.

## What's Changed
I got inspired to rewrite anything I didnt like and/or fully understood in this manual and thus this Release is born ### Main Changes: I Got Inspired Second Edition by @nicopop in https://github.com/nicopop/linklink/pull/9 - Made use of `hooks/Helpers.py` to remove unneeded locations/items/events before the magic even happen - This shorten the time it take for a magic a lot since it remove all the unused player if you didnt modify `hooks/data.py:MAX_PLAYERS` - converted the "extra" keys to be the same as normal keys so they count as progression/whatever classification "normal" keys are - extras are now removed at the same rate as normal keys: - if linklink Item A has 40 keys and 20 extras and it can only actually use 30 of them that is 75% so only 75% of extra are created aka 15 - added 1 event per level of a linklink that will now be used to track completion percent - aka all of `sword 1` has 1 event, `sword 2` has another - Reworked the goal to use a OptionCountPercent of these events and a new `keys_required` option - Made magic respect multiple options - if magic is not done in pre_fill, - It now scan `plando` for every item it could use and remove them from linklink - if your plando block could use 1 of either 2 items both get 1 removed from linklink - any item:count in `start_inventory_from_pool` is also removed from linklink - Other options also respected: - items listed in `local_items` are all removed from linklink - `item_links` are scanned so any item listed in `item_pool`/`local_items`/`non_local_items` of a item_link are removed from linklink - Made the regions be linked together instead of all being `"starting": true` - Now only the first level of each linklink item's region is marked as starting and now each region "connects_to" the next level - This organize the region graph per item instead of having all the region being next to each other on the same line - Included my "custom" version of the manual client that include all of my [open PRs](https://github.com/ManualForArchipelago/Manual/pulls/nicopop) - The goal shows how many events is required before you can goal thru the alias system added in one of the PR - Made it easier to add linklink keys (items) - You no longer need to add "progression": true, and "category": ["linklink"] to them its now done for you - you can still specify other item classification but ll keys are now allways at least progression - you can also specify custom categories and an appropriate linklink category will get added to it (changes if its in other items.json files - Non linklink items and location should now be fully supported - for those that wants to add some custom items/locations to their gimmic async or even some free hints - Updated the Sorting script to actually count the characters before each values instead of starting at the first value of each lines - lines are now wrapped if a value would go over 120 characters from the start of each line - Updated the README to include feature that are only in this fork of linklink
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nicopop/linklink/compare/1.2.1...1.3.0
Do report any bugs/issues either on [Github](https://github.com/nicopop/linklink/issues) or on Discord

Come hang out on [Appie's Games Discord](https://discord.com/invite/HxXy4mKQ5E). Test builds, bug reports and YAML sharing all happen there.
Alpha7 is a quick one. It adds a lot more AP box spots to the retail race tracks, so Item Box Count up to 50 now gives real choice on most of them. [Full notes on AP-Pie](https://beta.ap-pie.com/ctr/releases) · [Setup guide](https://ap-pie.com/guides/ctr)

Rooms from before alpha6 may be refused: keep the older client for them. Rooms made with alpha7 need the alpha7 client. Rooms from 0.2.x still need 0.2.4. - Quick saves (F5) made with alpha6 may not load. Make a new one if one is refused.

New spots need no boost. A few spots are still held back until they are tested by driving, so a few tracks have fewer than 50. - Custom tracks can have a separate build for Relic Races. A track with an Arcade build and a Relic build now offers both: Relic Races use the Relic build and every other mode uses the main one. entry.title: Civilization IV v0.0.1.post7
entry.content:
This is the release that 0.4 should have been, with lots of Resourcesanity fixes, as well as Wondersanity fixes.
### Changelog: New in 0.4.1: - Fur, Ivory, and Whale resources don't go obsolete anymore, regardless of the Resourcesanity settings. - Non-water resources now require The Wheel to be in logic (as it's impractical to connect them to the capital otherwise) - Receiving a city from another player (either through trade or capture) with a World Wonder sends the respective location check just as if you've built it. - Fixed Shrines attempting to send a location check - Prevented barbarians from spawning "AP" units
New in 0.4.0: - Resourcesanity is available in an initial form. A check is sent when you have at least one instance of a resource available in your capital, either by connecting it naturally or getting it via trade. The logic makes sure you have the techs needed to reveal and connect the given resource (or make a corporation for it in the case of Aluminum and Oil), and additionally requires Iron Working to connect Calendar resources (as the majority of them are placed in jungle on "normal" maps). You also aren't guaranteed to have every resource on every map and may need to generate another game to get all checks. - If Peekable Locations is set to either "Great People" or "All" in the YAML, the option to "bulb" a location will show the name of the item you're sending. In this initial implementation GPs are the only location that's peekable, it doesn't say who the item is for, or what type the item is (Progression/Useful/Filler/Trap), all of which are planned for later updates. - Fixed Archipelago Communism being named Archipelago Utopia, causing the location not to send. - Did lots of refactoring and code cleanup that's not interesting to users
### Installation Instructions: 1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure. 2. Install the APWorld as normal.
### Play Instructions: 1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client) 2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode. 3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**
### Gameplay Issues: 1. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill (though the added Great People in the pool will help). 2. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod. I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed. 3. When you're trying to select an "obsolete" wonder to build in the city screen, the building options will jump to the top of the building list due to the hacky way I've implemented that ability. I want to fix it eventually, but for now the easiest way to mitigate it is to use the wonder filter on the right side of the city list (the star), which will have it jump back to the start of the wonders, which hopefully won't make it jump. You can also use the "choose what to build next" dialog, or just select it without moving your mouse (use the scroll wheel). 4. The "AP" Unique Units can't be upgraded into, though they can be upgraded themselves. This is planned to be fixed in an upcoming update. 5. AP Unique Buildings are programmed assuming you don't have a "natural" Unique Building for your Civilization for purposes like avoiding duplicates of the same class of building, so if you use a Civilization other than AP World things could break. 6. If a building has a requirement to be built (such as the University), and you build an AP Unique Building version of it (such as the Seowon), you aren't able to build the original version anymore. There's no reason why you'd need to do this (the only vanilla building that's not strictly worse than the UB alternatives is the Theatre/Hippodrome, and that doesn't suffer the bug), but it's weird behavior.
### Technical Issues: 1. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds with high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with locations other than Techsanity enabled but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating. 2. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates. 3. There have been bug reports of items received/obtained while offline not properly appearing in-game and/or being sent to the multiworld when reconnecting. I think this is related to mismatching either mod or APworld versions, but I haven't fully found the root cause yet. 4. If you add Unique Buildings to the itempool, it causes a noticeable amount of lag when entering the city screen in some cases (due to the coding I need to make them work how I want them to). I think it scales with the amount of cities you have, but it also might be just a memory leak. If you experience this lag (or don't and think you would), let me know!
If you have any questions, bug reports, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in [the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1326231506682904576).
Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/

entry.content: ## Changes ### Fixed - **Seeds generate again with weapon slots per class.** With "weapon slots per class" on and class unlocks or weapon slots set to useful instead of progression, generation failed with "No more spots to place" items. - **A Docker server now tells you which address to join.** `make up` and the admin container's log print the `connect` line players type, and warn when `TF2AP_JOIN_HOST` is still the loopback default that only works on the host itself. The released `compose.yaml` says where the control panel is and what to give players. - **A Docker server on a LAN no longer loses its RCON port when the container is on a second network.** The game server binds to the address of its own Compose network instead of whichever one its hostname resolved to that boot. - **The debug bundle says whether Steam gave the server an address.** For a server played over Steam, the summary now names the relay address srcds got, or says it got none, which is why nobody could join. - **The server restart after a long time in a settings page now says why.** When SourceMod updates its gamedata while a settings page is open, the launcher waits and restarts the server once you apply or cancel. It now shows a notice with the reason instead of restarting for no visible cause. - **The launcher says why the server is not on your multiworld.** A wrong room address, a wrong slot name or a refused connection used to leave the Missions page empty with no reason. The Missions page now shows the reason, and a refusal that stops the server is shown as a notice. ## Windows Download **`tf2ap.exe`** above. Run it. It installs everything else. Windows will warn you, and it is a false positive. The exe unpacks archives and starts a game server without a code signature, which looks like a virus to a scanner. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**, or check it below first. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-windows.html) ## Linux Download **`tf2ap-linux-amd64`**. Run it. It installs everything else. ```sh chmod +x tf2ap-linux-amd64 ./tf2ap-linux-amd64 ``` [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install-linux.html) ## Docker Download **`compose.yaml`** and **`env.example`**: ```sh mkdir mann-vs-archipelago && cd mann-vs-archipelago base=https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/releases/latest/download curl -fsSLO "$base/compose.yaml" curl -fsSL -o .env "$base/env.example" ``` Set `SRCDS_RCONPW` in `.env`, then: ```sh docker compose --profile seed run --rm seed # writes ./seed docker compose up -d ``` Upload the file from `seed/` at [archipelago.gg/uploads](https://archipelago.gg/uploads) and put the room's port into `AP_PORT`. [Full guide](https://m-this.github.io/tf2-archipelago/en/setup/install.html) ## Other assets | File | For | | --- | --- | | `tf2_mvm.apworld` | The official Archipelago app. | | `tf2_archipelago.smx` | A SourceMod server the launcher and compose file don't manage. | | `tf2-defender-bots.zip` | The bots for that same server. Unzip into `tf/`. | | `meta.json`, `items.json`, `missions.json` | The item and check tables, for reference. | ## Checking what you downloaded **`SHA256SUMS`** is attached to this release. It holds the hash of every file here, computed by the workflow that built them. ```powershell Get-FileHash tf2ap.exe -Algorithm SHA256 # Windows ``` ```sh sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing # Linux ``` Each binary carries a signed record of the commit and the workflow that built it: ```sh gh attestation verify tf2ap.exe --repo m-this/tf2-archipelago ``` The binaries are scanned on VirusTotal, and the reports are linked at the end of these notes. Expect a few heuristic detections and no named malware family. The source is all in the repository, and `make launcher` rebuilds the exe on your own machine. ## Code signing policy Free code signing for open source projects, provided by [SignPath.org](https://signpath.org), with a certificate from the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). > [!WARNING] > The application is open, not granted. Nothing is signed yet: `tf2ap.exe` ships > unsigned, and Windows warns about it until that changes. ## What's Changed * fix(apworld): per-class slots generate with useful slots or classes by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/270 * fix(docker): say which address to join, bind srcds to its Compose network by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/271 * fix(bridge): say why the bridge is not on the room by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/272 * fix(launcher): say why the server restarts after a long settings window by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/273 * fix(debugbundle): say whether Steam gave the server a relay address by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/274 * fix(web): say why the Missions page is empty by @m-this in https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/pull/275 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/m-this/tf2-archipelago/compare/v1.18.9...v1.18.10 ## VirusTotal - [`tf2ap.exe`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/ZWYzMTA3YWM4MjdiOTFjOWVkZGNmN2MzMDU4NDBmNDk6MTc5NTc4MDQ4OQ==/detection) - [`tf2ap-linux-amd64`](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file-analysis/NTliMmFmOGY0ZTFkMGMyYzczYTMyODEzYWUwODdkNWQ6MTc5NTc4MDQ5MQ==/detection)

entry.title: Final Fantasy Resonance v0.32.0
entry.content:
# v0.32.0 (apworld 0.32.0, mod 0.63.0): public playtest, fifth build
The big change this time is the start. New Game (Archipelago) no longer plays the prologue and reloads. You start on foot next to your starting continent's main town, right away, and it works with autosave off too. There's also a bigger item pool, Aileen's forge as an optional set of locations, a pile of logic and key item fixes, and fast travel now only goes to places you've actually walked into. I also spent a couple of rounds on a stutter some of you reported. Please send feedback with the template in the [Playtester guide](https://github.com/wrjones104/ffresonance-archipelago/blob/main/docs/playtester_guide.md).
### Downloads
| File | Description | |---|---| | `FFRArchipelago.zip` | UE4SS Lua game mod (v0.63.0, build `2a1d876c`) | | `ff_resonance.apworld` | Archipelago world and Final Fantasy Resonance Client (v0.32.0, build `e0989726`) | | `Final Fantasy Resonance.yaml` | Template player YAML with default options |
### Install and upgrade
- Use the mod and the apworld from the same release. The mod logs `version 0.63.0 (build 2a1d876c)` to `UE4SS.log` when it loads, and the client prints `world version 0.32.0 (build e0989726)` when it starts. - Replace the whole `FFRArchipelago` folder in `ue4ss\Mods`, and put the new apworld in `custom_worlds`. Close the Launcher and every client window first. - Generate a new seed. The pool, the logic and the locations changed, and the template yaml now asks for world 0.32.0. - Start the client and connect it before you pick **New Game (Archipelago)** on the title screen. Without it the entry says "connect the client" and opens Load Game instead. - Install steps are in the [README](https://github.com/wrjones104/ffresonance-archipelago#installation).
### What's changed since v0.31.0
**A new start.** **New Game (Archipelago)** now builds the seed's game directly. There's no opening, no Archwitch Fina section, and no reload into the open world. You land on foot next to your starting continent's main town with your starting party at level 1. If the seed starts with the airship, it's parked right there next to you. This used to depend on the game's first autosave, so with autosave off the seed played the prologue and chapter 1 with Rain at level 55. That's gone.
- You can't walk until the mod has put you at the town (a second or two), so you can't wander off mid-move and freeze. - The client now writes a heartbeat file while it's connected. With no live client, the title entry reads **New Game (Archipelago: connect the client)** and opens Load Game with a notice, so you can't start a seed by accident on an old seed's settings. - Active Time Chats from the skipped story don't pop up at the start.
**Item pool.**
- 2 Ribbons and 13 accessories that used to be enemy-only are in the pool now. - New `extra_magicite` option (0 to 30, default 9): Magicite added on top of what the chests, shinies and bosses hold, split between Shards, Magicite and Crysts. - New `early_healing_vision` option (on by default, needs `shuffle_visions`): one vision that can cast Cure or Esuna goes early in your own world. - The Proofs of Victory are out of the pool. The Colosseum gives each one at its rank clear anyway.
**Aileen's forge.** New `include_aileens_forge` option (off by default). The forge on the airship deck becomes eight locations: your first forged weapon, your second, and so on. It opens after Forger of Wills, each weapon costs one Adamantite, and eight Adamantite go in the pool. You still get the weapon you pick.
**Key items.**
- With `shuffle_key_items` on, the squad leader in Zoldaad Castle no longer hands you the Throne Room Key, and the man by Sian's inn no longer gives the Cabin Key. - With it off, the Dungeon Key is given when you walk into Zoldaad Dungeon (its soldier never shows up in an open world seed), and the locations behind each key are in logic behind the game's own giver.
**Logic fixes.**
- The Abandoned Cabin's chest needs the Cabin Key, and two Zoldaad Castle chests need the Throne Room Key. - Token Legacy and Errand's End need the Throne Room Key. Beyond the Blue needs a party of 4. - Two shinies on Zoldaad's south-west tip and the Dirnado Far-SW Headland shiny need the airship.
**Fast travel.**
- Fast travel only goes to places you've walked into. A quest scene that carries you somewhere (The Tide from the Sky drops you in Grandport, the Ayaka quest runs through Zoldaad) doesn't count until you walk in yourself. Existing saves keep the places they already had. - Places on locked continents aren't fast travel targets. - The airship counts as visited when the seed starts with it, so it isn't grey on the Map screen.
**Things that stayed stuck after a fast travel out are fixed.** Fast travelling out of a dungeon used to leave things the way you left them, because in the base game you always walk out the way that resets them.
- Tower of Mysidia: taking the lift up and fast travelling out left the lift at the top for good, so you could never get back up. - The lifts in the Wind Shrine, Water Shrine, Gronoa Shrine and Sanctissimus Shrine go back to where they were on your first visit. - The rafts in Cave of Waters and the Water Shrine too. - Kolobos Ruins: the floor that falls under you is put back, as Rain's "elbow grease" scene does, so the way in isn't blocked.
**The airship.** On a seed where the airship is an item, it now shows up where you started the seed, not wherever the game felt like putting it (one came up near Zoldaad on a Dirnado start).
**Other fixes.**
- The first vision Moogle you talk to no longer plays Grandport's Moogle scene and leaves you out of bounds. Grandport Harbor has its vision Moogle now, so a Lanzelt start can upgrade visions. - Reloading the Archipelago game's save no longer gives you every early item a second time. - The two names in a two-reward pop-up don't touch anymore. - The radar goes quiet once everything it can find is dug, like in the base game, until your next Progressive Radar. - Lid's "we already found Mysidia" line on the airship is gone. - The Seed tab on the Archipelago page says `Start: on foot on <continent>, next to your airship`.
**The stutter.** A few of you felt a steady stutter, like a heartbeat. The mod's loop runs twice a second, and some of its steps did a lot of work at once. I split the slow steps across ticks and took out the worst ones: a full search of the talk event table every second for two rows, and a hook that retried every second until you opened the Quests screen. On my desktop the slow ticks went from 13 to 60 every 2 minutes down to about 5. The log now gets `perf:` lines every 2 minutes, and `ffrap_perf` in the console writes them right away.
### Please test
- **The stutter, especially on slower PCs and laptops.** Play for 10 minutes or so, towns included, and send the `perf:` lines from `UE4SS.log`. If you feel a stutter, run `ffrap_perf` right then and tell me. - **The new start.** Start a fresh seed with autosave on and off. You should land next to your continent's town with no opening, and with the airship next to you if the seed starts with it. Also try the title with the client closed. - **Fast travel.** A place a scene took you to shouldn't be a fast travel target until you walk in. Tell me if the Map screen still shows or travels to such a place. - **Lifts and rafts.** In the shrines above, ride a lift or raft, fast travel out, and come back in by the door. Everything should be where it was on your first visit. - **Story boss pop-ups.** When you beat a story boss, what did the item pop-up say? On my last run the mod didn't write into it, though the item still came in the feed. - **`include_aileens_forge`**, if you turn it on: each forged weapon should send one check, in order. - **`shuffle_key_items: false`**: walk into Zoldaad Dungeon, and the Dungeon Key should be in your bag with the cells open.
### Known issues
- A story boss's item pop-up can show the game's stand-in item instead of the Archipelago item. The check still goes out and the item comes in the feed. - The radar: Lid can say it stopped finding treasure while some are still left. A Progressive Radar received while flying turns the radar on, but its treasures only dig after a map change. - The "connect the client" label on the title only updates when the title screen is made again (quit to the title once). - Mobliz Shipyard's last lift still doesn't come up, so two chests and two shards there stay out of reach. - When two checks come at once (a chest right after a boss win), the second pop-up can show the game's own item. The check is still sent. - Character quests' stat bonuses (like "Attribute Bonus: Fina") aren't items. The quest gives them as in the base game. - The `ModSettings` Lua mod (from FFR Modding Tools) can crash the game a second or two after a map change, with or without this mod. To avoid it, turn off **Hint on map load** in its panel (F10), or set `ModSettings : 0` in `Mods\mods.txt`. - Mt. Thunderclap's shortcut ladder is invisible. You can still let it down from the top and climb it. - Not done yet: espers other than Siren come the vanilla way, and the Chamber of Arms and the Arena are untouched. - If you crash, send `Mods/FFRArchipelago/ap_trace.txt`, the crash folder in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\FFRS\Saved\Crashes`, and `UE4SS.log` before you start the game again.
Most of this project's code and docs were written with Claude and tested by hand; see [DISCLOSURE.md](https://github.com/wrjones104/ffresonance-archipelago/blob/main/DISCLOSURE.md) for details.
